notes: The portable C++ source exercises HLAreportFederateLost using only official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the C++ standard library. The adapter supplies the provider, application FOM, standard MIM, endpoint, callback model, and external process fault fixture. The application FOM supplies a valid non-empty FOM module list for federation creation; no application-class behavior is asserted. The portable source contains no Umbra headers, private registry access, provider-specific transport code, or fault-injection hook. The report producer designator is intentionally not asserted because the TCK does not claim a standard producer mapping for RTI-originated MOM interactions.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador createFederationExecutionWithMIM with an empty application FOM module list and adapter-supplied MIM, join, subscribe, resign, and destroy services with FederateAmbassador connectionLost and receiveInteraction callbacks
